description: Ministry of Jutice and Labour Relations - Collective Agreement entered into between the Employee's Federation of Ceylon and Ceylon Mercantile Industrial & General Workers''Union (CMU)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between employers and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, working conditions, overtime pay, and holiday arrangements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for employment relationships.
